claims.statement: Routing in frontend/src/App.tsx uses in-component role-based guards (adminOnly, managerOrAdminOnly, officeStaffOnly, strictAdminOnly, driverOnly, forwarderOnly) defined in App.tsx, each route is lazy-loaded with React.lazy + Suspense and wrapped in its own ErrorBoundary so a single crash never blocks navigation.

The TripForm is composed of composable cards under frontend/src/components/trip/ (TripInfoCard, JourneyLegsCard, FuelTollsRevenueCard with FuelSection + FuelAllocationEditor, AncillaryFeesCard, ContainerInstancesCard, ImagesNotesCard, TripInstructionsCard, TripChecklistPanel, TotalsPanel, ActionBar, TripSummaryCard, AllowanceSection, FuelModeToggle); useTripForm + useTripFormContext orchestrate them, useDirtyGuard + useBackShortcut warn on back-navigation, and TotalsPanel previews computeTripTotals from @tingting/shared so UI matches server math.

LocationAutocomplete is backed by Map4D via /api/maps (casbinAuthz('maps'), readable by all roles) and is used by TripForm legs and any origin/destination picker; it returns Vietnamese-formatted addresses with lat/lng.

Vietnamese-locale formatters in frontend/src/lib/format.ts: formatNumber uses vi-VN with . thousands separator, formatCompact abbreviates >=1M to tr / >=1B to ty / >=1K to k, formatCurrency returns 12.500.000 ₫, and a VND splitter returns { num, unit } so the dong sign / tr / ty renders at subtitle size next to the digits — used by the <Money> component.

UI primitives include <Money> (VND with subtitle-sized unit), statusStrip (3x20px color bar on every status display), empty-state illustrations via frontend/src/lib/emptyIllustrations.ts, confirm-dialog.tsx, Modal/Drawer, Toast in components/shared/, charts under components/charts/, and AssetIcon.tsx.

User-visible strings are Vietnamese (Lưu, Hủy, Đang tải…, Không có quyền truy cập, Không tìm thấy API), money uses ₫ suffix with no decimals, dates use vi-VN locale, and DRIVER/FORWARDER pages are mobile-first responsive.
